text:
{
  "found": true,
  "rule": {
    "trigger_kind": "incident",
    "event": "sfp_replaced",
    "symptoms": [
      "link_up",
      "optics_normal",
      "counters_zero"
    ],
    "stated_condition": "old units",
    "condition_is_relative": true,
    "action": "interface.bounce",
    "action_text": "Disable the interface, wait a bit, enable it again",
    "avoid": [
      "node.reboot"
    ],
    "excerpt": "Same thing as on the old units before. Disable the interface, wait a bit, enable it again. Don't reboot the node.",
    "said_by": "Erkki Expert",
    "said_by_role": "expert",
    "hedged": false,
    "first_hand": false,
    "outcome": "recovered",
    "outcome_excerpt": "Done, traffic is flowing again."
  },
  "reason": "The expert identifies a recurring issue on old units after SFP replacement where counters stay at zero despite link and optics being normal, and instructs to bounce the interface rather than rebooting the node."
}
